description: This Python source file defines a TurnTraceObserver class used for integrating conversation turn tracking with OpenTelemetry tracing. It manages spans for conversation sessions and individual turns, creating hierarchical trace structures, and interfaces with turn tracking events to start and end spans accordingly.

classes.name: TurnTraceObserver
classes.description: An observer class for managing OpenTelemetry tracing spans corresponding to conversation turns within a session, providing hierarchical tracing for conversation flows.

methods.name: __init__( self, turn_tracker: TurnTrackingObserver, conversation_id: Optional[str] = None, additional_span_attributes: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the TurnTraceObserver with turn tracker, conversation ID, and additional span attributes. Sets up event handlers for turn start/end events.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Stub method for processing a frame push event; no processing needed as tracing relies on turn events.

methods.name: start_conversation_tracing(self, conversation_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Starts a new conversation span, assigning conversation ID and setting span attributes.

methods.name: end_conversation_tracing(self)
methods.description: Ends the current conversation span and any active turn span, clearing related contexts and attributes.

methods.name: _handle_turn_started(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Handles turn start event by creating a new span, setting turn-related attributes, and establishing parent context if a conversation span exists.

methods.name: _handle_turn_ended(self, turn_number: int, duration: float, was_interrupted: bool)
methods.description: Handles turn end event by setting span attributes such as duration and interruption status, then ending the span.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_current_turn_context(self)
methods.description: Provides the span context of the current turn for external use, e.g., spawning child spans.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_turn_context(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the span context for a specific turn number.
